## plist

### `plist_create`

Creates a plist file using howett.net/plist to generate plist write telemetry

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Privilege | `none` |
| Minimum macOS | `10.10` |
| Tags | `plist`, `create`, `file` |
| Event types | `plist_create`, `plist_create_launchagent` |
| ATT&CK | [T1543](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/) Create or Modify System Process<br>[T1543.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/001/) Create or Modify System Process: Launch Agent |

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Sensitive | Default | Example | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | `path` | no | no | `"/tmp/macnoise_test.plist"` | `"/tmp/test.plist"` | - | Path for the created plist file |
| `bundle_id` | `string` | no | no | `"com.macnoise.test"` | `"com.example.app"` | - | Bundle ID value to embed in plist |
| `mode` | `string` | no | no | `"bundle"` | `"launchagent"` | one of `bundle`, `launchagent` | Plist mode: 'bundle' (default) writes CFBundle keys; 'launchagent' writes LaunchAgent keys |
